data.name: KB_0001_Message
data.value: Internal program error.

data.name: KB_0001_Action
data.value: Report the bug with the run ID.

data.name: KB_0101_Message
data.value: The selected source does not exist or is not readable by the service.

data.name: KB_0101_Action
data.value: Choose another folder or grant permissions.

data.name: KB_0102_Message
data.value: Sources in the job overlap (a folder and its subfolder).

data.name: KB_0102_Action
data.value: Remove the subfolder from the list.

data.name: KB_0103_Message
data.value: The job definition is invalid or not supported in this version.

data.name: KB_0103_Action
data.value: Fix the job definition (source, destination, key).

data.name: KB_0104_Message
data.value: No job with the given name exists.

data.name: KB_0104_Action
data.value: Check the job name (kobian status).

data.name: KB_0105_Message
data.value: The job is disabled — the run was skipped.

data.name: KB_0105_Action
data.value: Enable the job to run it.

data.name: KB_0106_Message
data.value: A job with this name already exists.

data.name: KB_0106_Action
data.value: Choose another job name.

data.name: KB_0107_Message
data.value: No run with this identifier was found.

data.name: KB_0107_Action
data.value: Check the identifier in the run history.

data.name: KB_0120_Message
data.value: The job import file does not match the kobian-export v1 schema — nothing was imported.

data.name: KB_0120_Action
data.value: Fix the file according to the error list (JSON path + reason) or export it again.

data.name: KB_0121_Message
data.value: The job import file exceeds the size, depth or job count limit.

data.name: KB_0121_Action
data.value: Split the export (kobian export --job ...) and import it in parts.

data.name: KB_0122_Message
data.value: The job file contains a value that looks like a secret — rejected.

data.name: KB_0122_Action
data.value: Remove passwords and keys from the file; credentials are given only as secretRef (file:name) in the Agent secret store.

data.name: KB_0123_Message
data.value: The job file contains scripts or actions (pre/post, runSql) — import does not accept them.

data.name: KB_0123_Action
data.value: Remove the actions from the file; scripts are configured by the administrator in the program after import.

data.name: KB_0124_Message
data.value: A job with this name already exists with a different definition — nothing was imported.

data.name: KB_0124_Action
data.value: Choose how to resolve the conflict: skip, overwrite or rename (--on-conflict skip|overwrite|rename).

data.name: KB_0201_Message
data.value: The schedule is invalid or too frequent.

data.name: KB_0201_Action
data.value: Fix the schedule.

data.name: KB_0301_Message
data.value: The password is too weak.

data.name: KB_0301_Action
data.value: Use a longer, less common password.

data.name: KB_0401_Message
data.value: The retention policy is invalid.

data.name: KB_0401_Action
data.value: Add a rule or shorten the retention hold.

data.name: KB_1002_Message
data.value: The repository requires a feature this program version does not support.

data.name: KB_1002_Action
data.value: Update Kobian Backup.

data.name: KB_1003_Message
data.value: An object with this identifier already exists in the repository.

data.name: KB_1003_Action
data.value: Run the job again; if it repeats, check the repository (check).

data.name: KB_1101_Message
data.value: The data file does not belong to this repository or key.

data.name: KB_1101_Action
data.value: Check that the destination was not swapped; run check.

data.name: KB_1102_Message
data.value: Cannot unlock the repository key (wrong password or modified key parameters).

data.name: KB_1102_Action
data.value: Check the password; if it is correct, the key file may have been changed.

data.name: KB_1103_Message
data.value: Data authentication failed (data corrupted or modified).

data.name: KB_1103_Action
data.value: Run check; restore from another version or copy.

data.name: KB_1104_Message
data.value: The repository header (kobian.repo) is invalid or has been modified.

data.name: KB_1104_Action
data.value: Check that the destination was not swapped; use the header copy from the snapshot.

data.name: KB_1201_Message
data.value: A repository lock with an invalid signature was found on the destination and ignored.

data.name: KB_1201_Action
data.value: Check who has write access to the destination; only the holder of the repository key may create locks.

data.name: KB_1202_Message
data.value: The repository is in use by another operation (locked).

data.name: KB_1202_Action
data.value: Wait for the backup or pruning to finish; the lock of an interrupted host expires after 30 minutes.

data.name: KB_1301_Message
data.value: Data frame exceeds the allowed size.

data.name: KB_1301_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1302_Message
data.value: Block exceeds the allowed size after decompression.

data.name: KB_1302_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1303_Message
data.value: Metadata object exceeds the allowed size.

data.name: KB_1303_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1304_Message
data.value: Metadata has an invalid structure (nesting or encoding).

data.name: KB_1304_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1305_Message
data.value: A directory in the backup has too many entries.

data.name: KB_1305_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1306_Message
data.value: Invalid entry name in the backup.

data.name: KB_1306_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1308_Message
data.value: The data file contains too many frames.

data.name: KB_1308_Action
data.value: Run check.

data.name: KB_1309_Message
data.value: The data file is incomplete or has an invalid layout.

data.name: KB_1309_Action
data.value: Run check; incomplete files are removed by prune.

data.name: KB_1401_Message
data.value: File changed while being read — stored with an unstable flag.

data.name: KB_1401_Action
data.value: Enable VSS or schedule the backup outside working hours.

data.name: KB_1402_Message
data.value: Repository write failed — run aborted, no snapshot created.

data.name: KB_1402_Action
data.value: Check the space and access to the destination, then run again.

data.name: KB_1403_Message
data.value: Reference inconsistency detected before snapshot commit.

data.name: KB_1403_Action
data.value: Run check; report the bug.

data.name: KB_1404_Message
data.value: Deduplication switched to Bloom filter mode (large repository).

data.name: KB_1404_Action
data.value: None - informational.

data.name: KB_1405_Message
data.value: Source file unreadable — skipped.

data.name: KB_1405_Action
data.value: Check permissions or file locks.

data.name: KB_1406_Message
data.value: The VSS snapshot could not be created — backup without a snapshot is not possible.

data.name: KB_1406_Action
data.value: Check the Volume Shadow Copy service and the event log; retry the backup.

data.name: KB_1501_Message
data.value: A pack referenced by the repository index is missing.

data.name: KB_1501_Action
data.value: Run kobian check --repair (D8.10); restore the affected files from another copy.

data.name: KB_1502_Message
data.value: The size of a pack on the destination differs from the size recorded in the index.

data.name: KB_1502_Action
data.value: Run kobian check with 100% sampling; check the medium or the destination server.

data.name: KB_1503_Message
data.value: A snapshot references a block that is missing from its indexes.

data.name: KB_1503_Action
data.value: Run kobian check --repair; make a full backup.

data.name: KB_1504_Message
data.value: The repository contains an object nothing refers to (e.g. after an interrupted job).

data.name: KB_1504_Action
data.value: No action needed - maintenance (prune) will remove the object; if the count grows, check the job log.

data.name: KB_1505_Message
data.value: The backup index was unavailable — blocks were found in an index rebuilt from data files.

data.name: KB_1505_Action
data.value: Run kobian check --repair and check the backup; make a new full backup.

data.name: KB_1510_Message
data.value: Periodic repository verification (V3) found damaged or missing backup data.

data.name: KB_1510_Action
data.value: Run kobian check --repair for the job; the next backup of the job will be full; check the medium or the destination server and restore from another copy (replica/USB).

data.name: KB_1511_Message
data.value: A backup recorded in the catalog does not exist in the repository on the destination (a different medium is attached or data was deleted).

data.name: KB_1511_Action
data.value: Check that the right medium/share is attached; if the data was deleted, make a full backup and restore from another copy (replica/USB).

data.name: KB_1601_Message
data.value: Prune stopped: a snapshot or index that must be kept cannot be read.

data.name: KB_1601_Action
data.value: Run kobian check; pruning removes nothing while the repository is not readable.

data.name: KB_1602_Message
data.value: Prune stopped: no backup would remain in the repository.

data.name: KB_1602_Action
data.value: Check that the job points to the right repository and that the catalog was not wiped.

data.name: KB_1603_Message
data.value: Prune stopped: the repository changed while objects were being deleted.

data.name: KB_1603_Action
data.value: Run pruning again later; nothing that is still needed has been removed.

data.name: KB_1604_Message
data.value: Index consolidation did not complete; the repository remains readable and complete.

data.name: KB_1604_Action
data.value: Nothing to do: the next pruning will repeat the consolidation. If it repeats, run kobian check.

data.name: KB_2001_Message
data.value: Transient connection or write error on the destination.

data.name: KB_2001_Action
data.value: None - automatic retry.

data.name: KB_2101_Message
data.value: The SMB server already has a connection under a different account (error 1219).

data.name: KB_2101_Action
data.value: Report the bug - jobs with different accounts to one server should be queued.

data.name: KB_2102_Message
data.value: The destination rejected the credentials (key or password).

data.name: KB_2102_Action
data.value: Fix the access key or password for the destination.

data.name: KB_2103_Message
data.value: The account on the server is locked, expired or must change its password.

data.name: KB_2103_Action
data.value: Unlock the account or change the password on the server, then update the destination credential.

data.name: KB_2104_Message
data.value: The SSH server host key does not match the pinned key (or none is pinned).

data.name: KB_2104_Action
data.value: Verify the server key fingerprint out of band and approve it in the destination settings.

data.name: KB_2105_Message
data.value: No permission to write to the destination.

data.name: KB_2105_Action
data.value: Grant permissions to the folder or share.

data.name: KB_2106_Message
data.value: The destination folder or share does not exist.

data.name: KB_2106_Action
data.value: Check the destination path.

data.name: KB_2109_Message
data.value: The FTPS/WebDAV (HTTPS) server certificate is untrusted or its key (SPKI) does not match the pinned one.

data.name: KB_2109_Action
data.value: Verify the server SPKI fingerprint out of band and approve it in the destination settings, or use a certificate from a trusted authority.

data.name: KB_2110_Message
data.value: The server does not support TLS encryption (FTPS: AUTH TLS refused; WebDAV: no HTTPS).

data.name: KB_2110_Action
data.value: Enable TLS on the server (FTPS or HTTPS) or use an SFTP destination.

data.name: KB_2112_Message
data.value: The server refused a new session (server limit).

data.name: KB_2112_Action
data.value: None - the program reduces the number of parallel connections.

data.name: KB_2114_Message
data.value: Connection attempts to the destination are paused for 10 minutes after 3 failures within an hour (protects the account and address from lockout).

data.name: KB_2114_Action
data.value: Check the credentials and the server availability; the next attempt will follow automatically after a pause.

data.name: KB_2115_Message
data.value: An unencrypted FTP/WebDAV destination requires explicit confirmation — connection refused.

data.name: KB_2115_Action
data.value: Use FTPS or SFTP; plain FTP only with the insecure-connection flag (the password is sent in clear text).

data.name: KB_2116_Message
data.value: The destination server rejected the object as too large (request size limit).

data.name: KB_2116_Action
data.value: Raise the upload size limit on the server to at least 64 MB (e.g. client_max_body_size in nginx, LimitRequestBody in Apache).

data.name: KB_2117_Message
data.value: The WebDAV server refused the request or does not support a required operation.

data.name: KB_2117_Action
data.value: Check that the address and path point to a WebDAV resource and that the server supports PROPFIND, MKCOL and MOVE.

data.name: KB_2141_Message
data.value: This fingerprint is not awaiting approval for this destination (only a fingerprint presented by the server and still pending can be approved).

data.name: KB_2141_Action
data.value: Check the list: kobian destinations identity list - and copy the exact fingerprint from the pending state.

data.name: KB_2142_Message
data.value: The server identity approval request has expired (24 h).

data.name: KB_2142_Action
data.value: Connect to the destination again (destination check or a job run), verify the fingerprint out of band and approve it within 24 h.

data.name: KB_2143_Message
data.value: The destination already has the maximum number of approved server keys (4).

data.name: KB_2143_Action
data.value: Approve the new key with the replace option (--replace) or remove the unneeded destination.

data.name: KB_2201_Message
data.value: No space left on the destination.

data.name: KB_2201_Action
data.value: Free up space or change the retention.

data.name: KB_2301_Message
data.value: An object with this name already exists on the destination — never overwritten.

data.name: KB_2301_Action
data.value: Report the bug.

data.name: KB_2302_Message
data.value: Invalid repository object name.

data.name: KB_2302_Action
data.value: Report the bug.

data.name: KB_2303_Message
data.value: The destination path contains a link — write refused.

data.name: KB_2303_Action
data.value: Remove the link from the repository folder.

data.name: KB_2401_Message
data.value: Object size or checksum on the destination differs from expected.

data.name: KB_2401_Action
data.value: None - retry; if it repeats, check the destination.

data.name: KB_3001_Message
data.value: Cannot connect to the SQL Server instance.

data.name: KB_3001_Action
data.value: Check that the SQL service is running.

data.name: KB_3002_Message
data.value: SQL Server rejected the login.

data.name: KB_3002_Action
data.value: Run the permissions script.

data.name: KB_3003_Message
data.value: BACKUP DATABASE permission is missing.

data.name: KB_3003_Action
data.value: Run the permissions script.

data.name: KB_3004_Message
data.value: SQL Server TLS certificate does not match the approved one.

data.name: KB_3004_Action
data.value: Approve the SQL Server certificate.

data.name: KB_3005_Message
data.value: The database does not exist on the SQL Server or is not ONLINE.

data.name: KB_3005_Action
data.value: Check the database state in SQL Server Management Studio or select the database again in the wizard.

data.name: KB_3006_Message
data.value: The SQL Server did not present a TLS certificate (encryption unavailable).

data.name: KB_3006_Action
data.value: Enable encryption and a certificate in SQL Server Configuration Manager, or check that the address points to a SQL Server.

data.name: KB_3007_Message
data.value: The SQL Server certificate changed after its fingerprint was shown — nothing was saved.

data.name: KB_3007_Action
data.value: Download the certificate again and compare the fingerprint with the SQL Server administrator.

data.name: KB_3008_Message
data.value: A certificate file with this name already exists with different content.

data.name: KB_3008_Action
data.value: Approve the certificate under a new name; the old file may be used by other jobs.

data.name: KB_3009_Message
data.value: The SQL Server is not on the list of servers allowed for this Kobian service.

data.name: KB_3009_Action
data.value: The administrator adds the server to KOBIAN_SQL_ALLOWED_SERVERS (name as in the job) and restarts the service.

data.name: KB_3010_Message
data.value: An ERP control query was skipped (timeout, missing read permission or disallowed result) — the backup is valid.

data.name: KB_3010_Action
data.value: Optionally grant the Kobian account read access (db_datareader) for the logical check after restore; without it the check will be incomplete.

data.name: KB_3101_Message
data.value: Another backup, restore or DBCC is running on the database — job skipped.

data.name: KB_3101_Action
data.value: None - the next run follows the schedule.

data.name: KB_3102_Message
data.value: Not enough space for the database backup staging file.

data.name: KB_3102_Action
data.value: Free up space or choose another volume.

data.name: KB_3103_Message
data.value: A foreign full backup was detected — a full backup was taken.

data.name: KB_3103_Action
data.value: None.

data.name: KB_3104_Message
data.value: Log backups made by another tool were detected.

data.name: KB_3104_Action
data.value: Find out which tool makes the log backups.

data.name: KB_3105_Message
data.value: Transaction log is growing — no log backups in FULL recovery.

data.name: KB_3105_Action
data.value: Consider log backups or the SIMPLE recovery model.

data.name: KB_3106_Message
data.value: SQL Server cannot write or read the backup file in the staging folder (permissions, path or free space).

data.name: KB_3106_Action
data.value: Grant the SQL Server service account read/write access to the staging folder and check the path and free space.

data.name: KB_3201_Message
data.value: The database has damaged pages (checksum error during backup).

data.name: KB_3201_Action
data.value: Run DBCC CHECKDB.

data.name: KB_3202_Message
data.value: Database backup verification (VERIFYONLY) failed.

data.name: KB_3202_Action
data.value: Run the backup again and test the restore.

data.name: KB_3203_Message
data.value: The msdb backup set does not confirm a full COPY_ONLY backup with checksums.

data.name: KB_3203_Action
data.value: Check that no other tool writes to the Kobian temporary folder; run the job again.

data.name: KB_3301_Message
data.value: TDE-encrypted database without a certificate backup.

data.name: KB_3301_Action
data.value: Include the TDE certificate.

data.name: KB_3401_Message
data.value: SQL Server version unsupported or out of vendor support.

data.name: KB_3401_Action
data.value: Update SQL Server.

data.name: KB_3501_Message
data.value: A target database with this name already exists — restore never overwrites existing databases.

data.name: KB_3501_Action
data.value: Provide another target database name (default <name>_restore_YYYYMMDD).

data.name: KB_3502_Message
data.value: The service account lacks CREATE ANY DATABASE on the SQL Server.

data.name: KB_3502_Action
data.value: Grant the service account the dbcreator role or the CREATE ANY DATABASE permission.

data.name: KB_3503_Message
data.value: The backup contains FILESTREAM or full-text files — restoring them is not supported yet.

data.name: KB_3503_Action
data.value: Restore the .bak file manually in SQL Server Management Studio.

data.name: KB_3504_Message
data.value: The SQL Server does not report default data and log directories.

data.name: KB_3504_Action
data.value: Set the default directories in the SQL Server settings or provide them in the restore request.

data.name: KB_3505_Message
data.value: The restored database does not match the control queries recorded at backup time.

data.name: KB_3505_Action
data.value: The database was created under a new name - check it before switching the application over; try an older backup.

data.name: KB_4101_Message
data.value: Outside the time window — the backup will run in the next window.

data.name: KB_4101_Action
data.value: None.

data.name: KB_4102_Message
data.value: Queue wait time exceeded — other jobs held the resource.

data.name: KB_4102_Action
data.value: Consider changing the job times.

data.name: KB_4103_Message
data.value: The previous run is still in progress.

data.name: KB_4103_Action
data.value: Lengthen the interval or the window.

data.name: KB_4104_Message
data.value: Event-triggered run budget exhausted.

data.name: KB_4104_Action
data.value: None; if it repeats, check the event source.

data.name: KB_4105_Message
data.value: The media was removed during the backup.

data.name: KB_4105_Action
data.value: Reconnect the drive - the backup will resume.

data.name: KB_4201_Message
data.value: A system clock jump was detected.

data.name: KB_4201_Action
data.value: None.

data.name: KB_4901_Message
data.value: Internal error: duplicate run of the same occurrence.

data.name: KB_4901_Action
data.value: Report the bug.

data.name: KB_4902_Message
data.value: Internal error: illegal run state transition.

data.name: KB_4902_Action
data.value: Report the bug.

data.name: KB_5001_Message
data.value: No write permission at the restore destination.

data.name: KB_5001_Action
data.value: Choose a folder you have write access to.

data.name: KB_5002_Message
data.value: No snapshot with the given identifier was found (or the prefix is ambiguous).

data.name: KB_5002_Action
data.value: Check the ID (kobian snapshots) or use a longer prefix.

data.name: KB_5003_Message
data.value: The backup does not contain a folder at the given path.

data.name: KB_5003_Action
data.value: Go back to the backup root and choose a folder from the list.

data.name: KB_5101_Message
data.value: Invalid name in the backup — file skipped.

data.name: KB_5101_Action
data.value: Check the restore report.

data.name: KB_5102_Message
data.value: The destination path is too long.

data.name: KB_5102_Action
data.value: Restore to a shorter path or to a ZIP.

data.name: KB_5103_Message
data.value: The destination file system cannot hold this item (e.g. FAT32).

data.name: KB_5103_Action
data.value: Restore to NTFS.

data.name: KB_5104_Message
data.value: Write through a link at the destination was refused.

data.name: KB_5104_Action
data.value: Check the target folder.

data.name: KB_5105_Message
data.value: Target file already exists — not overwritten.

data.name: KB_5105_Action
data.value: Choose an empty target folder or rename the existing file.

data.name: KB_5106_Message
data.value: Not enough free space in the destination folder for the files to restore.

data.name: KB_5106_Action
data.value: Free up space or choose another folder or a smaller scope.

data.name: KB_5201_Message
data.value: Restored file checksum mismatch — file quarantined.

data.name: KB_5201_Action
data.value: Run check; restore from another version.

data.name: KB_5202_Message
data.value: A data file required for restore is missing.

data.name: KB_5202_Action
data.value: Run kobian check.

data.name: KB_6101_Message
data.value: The backup job failed.

data.name: KB_6101_Action
data.value: Check the run details.

data.name: KB_6103_Message
data.value: No successful backup for longer than the required RPO.

data.name: KB_6103_Action
data.value: Check the job and the destination.

data.name: KB_6111_Message
data.value: A ransomware-like anomaly was detected; retention is paused.

data.name: KB_6111_Action
data.value: Review the comparison report and confirm or reject the change.

data.name: KB_6116_Message
data.value: The OS or SQL instance is out of vendor support or unpatched for over 60 days.

data.name: KB_6116_Action
data.value: Install updates or plan a migration.

data.name: KB_6117_Message
data.value: A system clock jump was detected; retention is paused until confirmed.

data.name: KB_6117_Action
data.value: Check the system time and confirm in the interface.

data.name: KB_6120_Message
data.value: The alert cannot be acknowledged or silenced (it does not exist, is resolved, or is not awaiting a response).

data.name: KB_6120_Action
data.value: Refresh the alert list and pick an alert that has been notified.

data.name: KB_6201_Message
data.value: The SMTP server rejected authentication (e.g. 550 5.7.30 — Basic Auth disabled).

data.name: KB_6201_Action
data.value: Check the login and password in the smtp.credentials file; for Microsoft 365 use OAuth2.

data.name: KB_6203_Message
data.value: E-mail notification delivery failed.

data.name: KB_6203_Action
data.value: Check the SMTP server, the recipient addresses and the audit log.

data.name: KB_6204_Message
data.value: The e-mail notification configuration is invalid.

data.name: KB_6204_Action
data.value: Fix the KOBIAN_SMTP_* variables and the smtp.credentials file.

data.name: KB_6205_Message
data.value: The e-mail address is invalid or unsafe.

data.name: KB_6205_Action
data.value: Provide a single address in the form name@domain, without control characters.

data.name: KB_6206_Message
data.value: Could not establish an encrypted connection to the SMTP server (TLS or certificate).

data.name: KB_6206_Action
data.value: Check the server certificate and STARTTLS/TLS support.

data.name: KB_6207_Message
data.value: E-mail notifications are sent without encryption (plain SMTP).

data.name: KB_6207_Action
data.value: Enable STARTTLS or TLS on the server and remove KOBIAN_SMTP_INSECURE.

data.name: KB_6208_Message
data.value: The identity provider rejected the OAuth2 token request for e-mail notifications.

data.name: KB_6208_Action
data.value: Check the tenant id, application id and the secret in smtp.oauth, and the application's SMTP.SendAsApp permission.

data.name: KB_6209_Message
data.value: The OAuth2 authentication configuration for e-mail is invalid.

data.name: KB_6209_Action
data.value: Fix the KOBIAN_SMTP_OAUTH_* variables and the smtp.oauth file.

data.name: KB_6301_Message
data.value: Webhook delivery failed after all retries.

data.name: KB_6301_Action
data.value: Check the recipient address.

data.name: KB_6302_Message
data.value: The webhook URL is blocked (local or unsafe address).

data.name: KB_6302_Action
data.value: Use a public https address.

data.name: KB_6501_Message
data.value: Audit log verification failed.

data.name: KB_6501_Action
data.value: Report a security incident; keep a copy of the catalog.

data.name: KB_7013_Action

data.name: KB_7016_Action
